fact: The World Bank's June 2020 diagnostic lists PROBMIS as an integrated public financial and budget management system run by the Ministry of Finance with all ministries connected; it gives the date as the report's published date, 2020-06.
The World Bank's June 2020 diagnostic lists ANTILOPE as the payroll management system for public servants (salaries and pensions); it gives no other date than the report's published date, 2020-06.

The public service minister presented AIGLE, the platform managing state agents' staff and payroll, with over 342,049 promotion and tenure acts processed automatically since 1 January 2025 and over 3 million payslip notifications sent, per figures given at the summit.

The civil service payroll and personnel systems SIGIPES (about 30 years old) and ANTILOPE were still the payroll platform in November 2024, to be fully replaced by AIGLES expected the following year, per MINFOPRA.
MINFOPRA's minister launched national training on AIGLES, the career and payroll system, after its initial deployment, with exercises on payroll management.
